input_contract: Implement RZHedge for original attempt0 and one delayed attempt1. Choose the first acceptable response before the shared deadline, request cancellation of outstanding attempts, and track their actual terminal completions separately. Expose result availability independently from quiescence. Add a completion arbiter with two concurrent workers in the dedicated local harness, each retaining its own response storage, and integrate deduplicated effects when both attempts reach the receiver.
expected: A rejected response7 at1 does not win. Start the hedge at2; acceptable8 at3 wins. If original0 remains outstanding, result8 is available but quiescent is false and cancel_requested includes0. Its later response7 cannot replace8; only its completion makes the operation reclaimable.
independent_oracle: Enumerate started/completed masks, both acceptable bits, completion orders and deadline equality. Assert first acceptable value stability and that quiescence means every started attempt terminated. Count active permits until loser acknowledgement. The public model is serialized; concurrent correctness requires the submitted arbiter and its synchronization proof, not merely passing this model.
